title: Cargo
description: Physical shipment measure — the LOGISTIC-UNIT description of the goods as shipped (the package/shipment level, distinct from the per-item TRADE-ITEM measures a seller authors on its catalogue): gross/net mass, volume, packaged dimensions, and the kind / number / marks of the packages. Elective and NEVER default-on: composed only when an order moves physical goods. Density (mass ÷ volume) informs freight classification (declared NMFC class lives in figaro-freight-class); the packaged dimensions drive dimensional (billed) weight (figaro-dimweight).

fields.name: massGrams
fields.description: Shipment GROSS mass in whole grams (contents + packaging — the physical weight carriers bill against). Must be at least 1 g; capped at uint32 max (≈4.29 million kg).

fields.name: netMassGrams
fields.description: NET mass in whole grams (contents only, excluding packaging). Optional — declared when gross and net differ materially (customs / duty). GDSN net weight.

fields.name: volumeMl
fields.description: Shipment volume in whole millilitres. Must be at least 1 ml; capped at uint32 max (≈4.29 million L). Derivable from the packaged dimensions below when those are present.

fields.name: lengthMm
fields.description: Packaged LENGTH in whole millimetres — the logistic-unit dimension (the shipped package, not the trade item). Optional; drives dimensional weight and oversize/girth rules, which read each dimension separately (a single volume cannot reproduce per-dimension rounding or longest-side surcharges).

fields.name: widthMm
fields.description: Packaged WIDTH in whole millimetres. See lengthMm.

fields.name: heightMm
fields.description: Packaged HEIGHT in whole millimetres. See lengthMm.

fields.name: packagingType
fields.description: Kind of package — e.g. carton / pallet / crate / drum / bag. Free text referencing the UN/CEFACT Recommendation 21 package-type codes; the external standard is the source of truth. GDSN packaging type.

fields.name: packageCount
fields.description: Number of packages in the shipment (e.g. 10 cartons). The 'number and kind of packages' a bill of lading enumerates, paired with packagingType.

fields.name: marks
fields.description: Shipping marks & numbers — the identifiers and handling marks on the package(s) (consignee marks, order references, handling symbols). Free text; the 'Marks & Numbers' column on a bill of lading / packing list. A committed PUBLIC field: use reference codes per bill-of-lading practice, never personal names — party particulars travel the encrypted address channel.
